chapter: Piano influences and the New Orleans scene
title: Otis Spann and the harmonica player Benson again
summary: Marquez asks about Otis Spann and local harp players; they circle back to Benson and mention Louis Armstrong living next door.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: What do you think, you know Otis Spann? You ever heard him? He's Muddy Waters, our piano player. No, he wasn't from here. No, no. He's up around Chicago. No, I don't know. I don't think he played in New Orleans really. But I thought you might have known him somehow. Did you know any other people around here at the time, like doing stuff like, playing piano? Yeah, anybody playing harp or anything like that?
Oh yeah, I'm sure I know this, Slim. How poor are you talking about it? His name, his records sound familiar, you know?
Yeah. I wish I could call his real name so I could... His name is Benson, though.
Yeah. I don't know whether it's John, I think it's Johnny. No. His name is Benson, too. His name is this?
Yeah, just like that Johnny Benson. Yeah. Yeah. Louis Armstrong, Louis Armstrong.
He was right next door to us when we were up there.
Before the house break down. Before that, we don't know anything about it. Yeah.
